svg.title: Capsule: source-local groups in one Cube Restack execution
svg.desc: A pastel architecture example showing task and API inputs, initial code generation, a source overview, five ordered groups with exact supplied code excerpts, and source-bound feedback. All API calls return success and all five steps remain incomplete. Only steps one through five of a 22-step execution are shown.

g.text: From a generated program to source-local execution groups
Place the red cube on top of the green cube,
AST structure · variable dependencies · API-declared effects
Home reached; no local task progress.
Pose and extent are sampled once.
The sampled orientation is reused later.
Reward improves, but the task is unfinished.
The 0.15 m lift command returns success.
The intended lift is not established.
Geometry is reused from an earlier observation.
After G5, the initial program is exhausted and the world has changed.
No rollback / replay of these groups; recovery proceeds from fresh observation.
Code excerpts and rewards follow the supplied trace. Source spans refer to the original program; stage names are explanatory labels.
G4 subtraction is preserved as pasted. Later steps are not shown.
